reviewed_by: Claude Code, PR 2b of the Butler home worker design at the operator's request
reason: Stacked on PR #1242. Butler's home worker sends changes to its focus project as butler.action/v1 commands: host RPCs (submit, result) accept only the home lease and Butler's listed work changes and resend idempotently; the host stamps a 10-minute expiry and submits on the target's control lane only when its live owner, staged target and any handoff target declare the feature (an older worker would leave the command uncertain and block that lane); DurableHttpRunner runs the target handler, which re-validates, refuses expired or archived, runs dispatch_work_tool and never leaves the command uncertain; the gateway sends nebula.work.* changes this way. Selected: the new action suite plus PR 1/2a home suites; runtime delivery, coordination, orphan recovery and execution worker (runner branch, typed control command, worker wiring); host services and host search (new RPCs and capability); worker features, bundle and mixed-release (new release feature); Butler sessions and provider tools-context (gateway construction).
exclusions: tests/v3/test_butler_capabilities.py and tests/v3/test_settings_assistant_tools.py each contain a case that fails identically on unmodified origin/main 8fb8023 (after #1240), so they are not selected. No UI or operator-visible change: NEBULA_BUTLER_HOME_WORKER is off and no UI reserves a home session yet, so frontend and Playwright selections are empty and LAN validation does not apply. PostgreSQL cases skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL in CI; every selected file passed locally on SQLite and the staging postgres:16 (nebula_pytest), with the product knowledge index built locally as CI builds it.
